query: What was the Roud Folk Song Index of the nursery rhyme inspiring What Are Little Girls Made Of?

pipeline_result.response: The Roud Folk Song Index of the nursery rhyme "What Are Little Girls Made Of?" is a collection of nursery rhymes, which are songs that children listen to and learn. The Roud Folk Song Index was created by Solomon Grundy in 1929 when he wrote the nursery rhyme. It has been compiled into a list of 821 nursery rhymes with an R-value rating of 40% (Rundown).
